rationale.verdict: UltraYield Curator appears to be a curation / infrastructure-coordination layer that directs users to yield strategies on partner protocols (Upshift, Veda, Midas, Hyperbeat, Term Finance) rather than a protocol with deployed control contracts. No UltraYield-owned contract addresses, admin roles, proxy admin roles, or governance contracts were discovered via documentation, GitHub, or attempted block-explorer searches. The protocol model may be entirely off-chain (frontend + algorithm) or rely on third-party deployment; without access to a GitHub repo or on-chain searches per chain, no addresses can be catalogued. Grade set to 'unknown' due to incomplete discovery corpora.

evidence.shows: Website homepage with metadata. Title: 'UltraYield - DeFi Yield Farming Platform'. Description: 'UltraYield curates market-neutral DeFi strategies and offers secure, transparent infrastructure to launch yield-generating vaults.'

Main documentation page. States: 'UltraYield is onchain strategy curator working with top-tier protocols to bring depositor the highest yield possible on the market. Any deposits made into the vaults curated by our team are fully permissionless and don't allow direct access to funds by UltraYield team - instead, we identify market opportunities and interact only with pre-approved well-established protocols to find market-netural strategies that earn yield on any market: both bull and bear'

Lists active vault partnerships: Kelp High Growth ETH (via Upshift), EtherFi UltraYield Stablecoin vault (via Veda), Midas mEDGE and mBASIS, Turtle tacUSD predeposit (via Veda), Hyperbeat Ultra HYPE (via Upshift), Term Finance. All deposits directed to partner platform UIs; no UltraYield contract addresses provided.
Quickstart page shows placeholder text 'Coming soon'; no technical contract details or deployment instructions provided.

protocol_metadata.about: UltraYield is an onchain strategy curator that partners with top-tier protocols to identify and direct depositors to market-neutral DeFi yield strategies. The platform does not directly hold user deposits; instead, all funds remain in pre-approved partner protocols (Upshift, Veda, Midas, Hyperbeat, Term Finance) managed via their respective infrastructure. Model is permissionless with no direct fund access by the UltraYield team.
